newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INTERVIEW - Telkom sees no share sell-off.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Telkom sees no share sell-off.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Friday it was optimistic the firm's employees would not launch a sell-off of their allotted shares after a lock-up period ends in November.
Telkom is also listed in London and in New York apart from Jakarta and Surabaya.
"It's up to the government to decide whether to sell additional shares, we don't have the right to make that decision," Nasution said.
State-owned telecommunications giant Telkom plans a roadshow in Japan, Hong Kong, Britain and the United States between September 17 to September 27.
"The roadshow is aimed at promoting more understanding between the firm and the public, including our investors and analysts and explaining the progress of the company," Nasution said.
